title: Ya’ll are not ready for Kelli O’Hara’s “Back to Before” #Broadway #Mu...
transcript: We finally have a release date for the ragtime reunion concert that was filmed and performed last year, and it's actually coming pretty soon. It's going to be in theaters in the US March 13th and 17th. As of now, there are no international dates, but hopefully we get those soon. But if you've been following this page for a while, you know that Right Time is one of my all time favorite musicals. I got to see this concert in person last year, and it was one of the most magical theater experiences I have ever had because this original cast is iconic. I mean, you have Brian Stokes, Mitchell, Audrey McDonald, Peter Freeman, and then, of course, for the concert, you had Kelly O'hara stepping in for the late Mara Massi, who originated the role of mother. You can get your tickets at ragtime reunion concert. Com. You can also check Showtime is there to see if it's playing at a theater near you. If it is, I highly recommend checking this out. I promise you, you will not regret it. It is a fantastic piece of theater.
